answer: Once per epoch the registry's yarrow sounds at a random minute, and pending applicants are drawn into triads of strangers. All three must sign the same willow in one 30-second window, answering random prompts; one operator can watch only one live channel at a time, so a late answer voids the triad and all three re-queue. Only ten triads clear per bell, so the k-th puppet waits k/30 bells; the thousandth pays 34 shifts, the first one: 1,000 puppets need about 17,000 shifts at $2, about $34,000, while an honest applicant answers once, free, and mints their kernel at the first bell.
